entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF886-0921.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now. I see an order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color is just not what I expected. It's a preference, obviously.
I understand. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 62 days ago.

No problem at all. I'm looking at our policy and it states that you have 90 days for a return. So you are well within that window. As long as the item is in its original condition, we can process a full refund for you.
Fine. The box is unopened, so I would hope it's in original condition.

Perfect. That makes it easy. Your safety is our priority, and we want to make sure you're completely happy with the helmet you choose to wear. I've just initiated the return authorization for you. I'm sending an email to the address on file right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Do you have access to that email?
Whatever. I'll find it. Just send it.
The email has been sent. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
